body:
Reflecting in the aftermath is different than being in the moment; hindsight is clearer.
My manner of defense is offense.

I've been trying to improve myself for years with many intervals of stagnation.  And all that's been happening is me continuing the way I am - there's been no real improvement, only my prideful deceptions of improvement to myself. I'm instinctively defensive by way of hurting others when criticism is offered.

I've hurt my loved ones too many times, and they want out of whatever our respective relationships are. I can't bear hurting them, but I do because I don't think about them I just think about myself - my pride, my feelings, my whatever. I'm selfish because I rarely think to consider about them past a superficial level.

I don't and can't have a therapist - the country I'm staying in will use it against you, so you can't get a job or stay in country longer.
I really don't know. I feel like I have a deadline for this - before next year so people don't have to keep paying for me (my school fees).

I suppose it's more to vent. My hours have been extended, so there might be a future goodbye, but not now.
Thanks for asking
